behavior: Use the existing OpenSpeed value as the request interval, including0; first take immediate.
Native pending command and live attachment/receipt proof remain mandatory; reply latency is not added to the selected interval.
Initial bounded snapshot admits the candidate list; later proven attachments do not await another full-inbox scan.
Background authoritative snapshots remain bounded and wake the same worker; no overlapping owner.
Successful identical-mail continuation retains its deadline; abort/failure clears it so manual/combat retry is not stuck.
Current setting changes reschedule the active deadline; ordinary Select/Open All behavior and settings are preserved.
initialFocusedFailures: Two existing abort/combat retry checks exposed a retained cancelled deadline; fixed by clearing only aborted/failed session deadlines. Price/receipt checks were not relaxed.

resources.timers: Existing progress/timeout timer slots; snapshot completion wakes the owner instead of speed-based rescan polling.
